reason: ACHV is a contractor too and I don't want a competitor on my site seeing my programme and my clients. I've never paid for window protection on houses and small blocks; we cover frames with tape and film ourselves and it costs next to nothing.
objection: A competitor's people on my site, with a survey and supervision, plus a new supplier and a 50% deposit up front on a job where I'm watching my cash.
instead: Keep taping and filming the frames myself with cheap local film, and wipe or fix the odd scratch at handover.
would_change_my_mind: Nothing about the price. Only if it was clearly a product supplier with no contracting arm and I could buy it from my usual merchant and apply it with my own men.
